description: Current alerts for a park or a whole state — closures, hazards, caution notices, and information — with category and recency surfaced first so "is anything closed at Glacier right now?" is answered at a glance. Get park codes from nps_find_parks, or pass a stateCode for a statewide "what's closed" sweep. Returns most-recent-first. An empty result with totalCount 0 means no active alerts match the request (with category or query set, alerts outside that filter may still be active); an empty page with a non-zero totalCount means start ran past the end of the matches. Closures and road conditions change daily.

category.description: Filter to one alert category. "Danger" and "Park Closure" are trip-affecting. Combined with parkCode/stateCode/query and applied before start/limit, so totalCount counts every matching alert, not one page. Omit to see all categories.

limit.description: Maximum alerts to return (1–50), most-recent first.

parkCode.description: Park code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "glac", "yose,zion") — 4-letter lowercase codes. Get codes from nps_find_parks. Provide parkCode or stateCode; with neither, returns recent alerts service-wide.

start.description: Zero-based offset for pagination within the matched set. Use with limit to page through results — when totalCount exceeds what was returned, re-request with start advanced by limit.

stateCode.description: Two-letter state code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "MT", "WY,MT,ID"). Returns alerts for all NPS sites in those states — use for a statewide sweep rather than one park.

name: nps_get_alerts

alerts.description: Current alerts, most-recent first. Empty with totalCount 0 means no active alerts match the request; empty with a non-zero totalCount means start ran past the end of the matches.

items.description: A single alert with its category, recency, and detail.

category.description: Alert category: "Danger", "Park Closure", "Caution", or "Information". Danger and Park Closure are trip-affecting.

description.description: Full alert text — what is affected and any guidance.

lastIndexedDate.description: When NPS last updated/indexed this alert (YYYY-MM-DD), or null. The recency signal — a stale date may mean the condition has changed.

parkCode.description: Park code the alert belongs to — useful when querying by state across multiple parks.

title.description: Short alert headline (e.g. "Tioga Road Closed for the Season").

url.description: Link to more detail on NPS.gov, or null when absent.

cap.description: Limit applied (populated when results were truncated).

categoryBreakdown.description: Count of returned alerts per category, most severe first (e.g. "Park Closure: 3, Caution: 1, Information: 2").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_park_code`: A parkCode token isn't 4 lowercase letters. `invalid_state_code`: A stateCode token isn't two letters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance on the result set: whether an empty page means no active alerts match (totalCount 0) or start ran past the end of the matches, the start value for the next page when more alerts matched, and a best-effort disclosure when the category filter could not cover every alert.

shown.description: Alerts returned in this response (populated when capped by limit).

totalCount.description: Total alerts matching the filter before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more alerts matched than this response returned; absent on a complete result.

title: national-parks-mcp-server: get alerts
